decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 11.2	The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension, as shown on drawing numbers CF9254-1 and CF9254-2, received 11 October 2005, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing house.
